display.title: The Haggadah Explained for Children: From Bedikas Chametz to Eliyahu HaNavi
display.summary_short: A Yiddish walk through Erev Pesach and the Seder for children, page by page through the Haggadah: searching for chametz, the Seder plate, the Four Questions, the Four Sons, the Ten Plagues and Dayeinu.
display.summary_long: Told in Yiddish to children, almost four hours long, opening the Haggadah page by page. It begins with the cover picture of a deer leaping over the mountains, like Hashem passing over the Jewish homes. Then come the Erev Pesach customs: cleaning, the search for chametz with a candle, feather and wooden spoon, the fast of the firstborn and the siyum, burning and selling chametz, resting before the Seder, and the Rebbe's matzah given out at 770. Next is how to set the Seder plate. Then each step of the Seder: Kiddush (with the Shabbos and Motzaei Shabbos additions), Urchatz, Karpas and Yachatz. Magid takes up most of the class: Ha Lachma Anya, the Four Questions sung together, Avadim Hayinu, the sages in Bnei Brak and Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah's eighteen white hairs, and the Four Sons with the Rebbe's teaching on why the wicked son sits next to the wise son. It goes on through the Egyptian exile, the Ten Plagues, the plagues at the sea and Dayeinu. The class continues with Rabban Gamliel's three things, Hallel and the second cup, matzah, maror, Korech, the meal and the afikoman, Chabad care about wet matzah, Bentching, and ends as the door is opened for Eliyahu HaNavi. Several songs are sung along the way.
display.lesson: Every Jew should see himself as if he left Egypt tonight; we tell the story to our children, thank Hashem for every kindness, and look forward to the coming of Moshiach.

advisories.note: Slavery in Egypt as told in the Haggadah, including Pharaoh's decree to throw baby boys into the Nile, and 'in every generation they rise against us'.
The plague of the firstborn and the Egyptians drowning in the sea, as in the Haggadah.

segments.title: The Haggadah's cover: the leaping deer
segments.summary: Like a deer leaping over mountains, Hashem passed over the Jewish homes, and Moshiach will come just as quickly.

segments.title: Bedikas chametz: the search for chametz
segments.summary: Cleaning ahead of time, the ten hidden pieces, the candle, feather and wooden spoon, the brachah, and searching every corner without talking.

segments.title: Kol Chamira at night
segments.summary: The declaration that any chametz not found should be like dust, explained word by word.

segments.title: Erev Pesach morning: the fast of the firstborn and the siyum
Burning and selling the chametz
segments.summary: Burning the chametz, selling the rest to a non-Jew, the second Kol Chamira, and the prayer that Hashem remove the 'chametz' of the whole world.

segments.title: Resting before the Seder and the Rebbe's matzah
segments.summary: Children nap on Erev Pesach so they can stay up for the Seder, then go to 770 for a piece of the matzah the Rebbe sends out.

segments.title: Seder Korban Pesach after Mincha
Helping at home, Erev Pesach customs and candle lighting
segments.summary: Helping parents is a great mitzvah; washing hands that may have touched chametz; no matzah or charoses ingredients on Erev Pesach.

segments.title: Setting the Seder plate
segments.summary: Three matzos for Kohen, Levi and Yisroel, and the six items arranged in two segol shapes.

segments.title: The signs of the Seder order
Song: Kadesh Urchatz
Kadesh: Kiddush, Yaknehaz and the first cup
segments.summary: Making Kiddush right away, the additions for Shabbos, Havdalah when the Seder falls on Motzaei Shabbos, and drinking while leaning.

segments.title: Urchatz: washing without a brachah
Karpas
Yachatz and hiding the afikoman
Ha Lachma Anya: the bread of poverty
Mah Nishtanah: the Four Questions
segments.summary: Why the child asks, what each question means, and the Four Questions sung together twice.

segments.title: Avadim Hayinu
The sages in Bnei Brak
Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah's eighteen white hairs
segments.summary: Chosen as leader at eighteen, he wakes to find his beard has turned partly white.

segments.title: The Four Sons
segments.summary: The wise, wicked, simple and silent sons, each question and answer, and why the Seder starts on the night of Pesach.

segments.title: The Rebbe: why the wicked son stands next to the wise son
From idol worship to the Covenant Between the Pieces
Vehi She'amdah and how to hold the cup
Song: Vehi She'amdah
Arami Oved Avi: going down to Egypt, slavery and the cry
segments.summary: Lavan's plan, Yaakov's family growing into a nation set apart by their names, language and dress, the hard labor, and the Jews crying out to Hashem.

segments.title: Hashem Himself took us out: the five expressions
segments.summary: Not through an angel or a messenger; the strong hand, outstretched arm, great awe, signs and wonders, and spilling wine at 'blood, fire and pillars of smoke'.

segments.title: The Ten Plagues and Rabbi Yehudah's signs
The plagues at the sea: fifty, two hundred, two hundred fifty
Dayeinu explained: fifteen kindnesses
Song: Dayeinu and Al Achas Kamah V'chamah
Rabban Gamliel: Pesach, Matzah and Maror; in every generation
Lefichach, Hallel and the second cup
Rachtzah and Motzi Matzah
Maror and Korech, the way Hillel did it
Shulchan Orech and Tzafun: the meal and the afikoman
Barech: Eliyahu's cup, mayim acharonim and keeping matzah dry
segments.summary: Everyone gets a cup for Bentching, the custom of not letting matzah get wet, and eating it wet on Acharon shel Pesach.

segments.title: The Rebbe Maharash wipes his fork
The fourth cup and opening the door for Eliyahu HaNavi
Song: Eliyahu HaNavi
segments.summary: The recording ends in the middle of the song.

relations.note: Alternate take / cut of the same material.

quality.notes: Ends mid-song as the door is opened for Eliyahu; Hallel and Nirtzah are not included. ASR loops at about 43:40, 79:45 and in Dayeinu (3:00-3:05). Loshn-koydesh quotations are garbled.
